NOW NOW NOHO appeared in at least one AI answer for 12.7% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 3.2% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

AI currently reflects 28.6% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
